calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  d.fiscal_period_label,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN fwo.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN fsl.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(fsl.net_amount), 1) AS click_collect_share_pct
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
JOIN fact_web_order fwo ON fsl.receipt_id = fwo.web_order_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', fwo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 35 AND 43
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_period_label
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period;
